Rooms.Name: A Gravel Road on the Graveyard
Rooms.Description:
You are on a well-kept gravel road that leads north-south through the
graveyard. On both sides of the road grow dark evergreen trees. An iron grate
is to the north.

Exits.Description: Through the solid iron bars you see the Concourse.
The gravel road continues southward.

Rooms.Name: In front of the Chapel
Rooms.Description:
You are on an open space before a small chapel. A gravel road leads north
through the graveyard and the chapel entrance is to the south.

Exits.Description: The gravel road continues northwards.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.
The chapel door is made of dark wood.
There are a few old and weathered gravestones there.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Chapel
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small, dark chapel. The dark brown glass in the tiny windows do
not let much light through. A few rows of worn wooden benches stand here and an
ancient altar sits in the middle of the floor.

Exits.Description: The chapel door is made of dark wood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The benches are not of the comfortable kind.

Rooms.Name: The Gravestones
Rooms.Description:
There are several old and weathered gravestones here that mark 
the graves of Midgaard's formor citizens and heros.  One such 
grave has several fresh flowers laid over it and a prominent 
headstone.
This place is very cold and silent.
§N

Exits.Description: There are a few old and weathered gravestones are there.
You see a long row of gravestones.
To the west is the entrance to the Chapel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the tombstone and flowers, you see that the
flowers are fell laid out by someone who cares.
You guess that it is done daily.
The tombstone is not large or remarkable, but it simply has:
          STOMPER SHADOWLORD
Devoted Son of Chelendria and Pendragon
Survived by 2 brothers and both parents.
He lies here dead of a terminal heart disease -- a broken heart.
  "May he rests with the shadows which was his home,
   May he live with the friends of long time gone,
   May he run in the life that knows him best,
   May he find and remember all days gone long past."
                          -- Johannes --
§N

Rooms.Description:
There are paintings done in relief on both sides of this chamber. The
symbols of evil are present everywhere you look. To the south the passage

spiral staircase leads up to the surface.

Exits.Description: A small dark tunnel leads north.
A large dark tunnel leads south.

Rooms.Description:

Exits.Description: To the north is a small dark chamber.

west. To the south the large passage continues. Was that the wind? Or did you

Rooms.Description:
This massive chamber is at least six times larger than the little church.
The ceiling is at least 30 feet up! Two rows of columns form a procession to

Exits.Description: It is to dark to tell.

Three steps lead up to the dais. An altar made of a huge block of obsidian

Exits.Description: A door is concealed behind the mural.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A mural depicting a skeletal figure riding a dracolich into battle.  The
humanoid figure wields a glowing glasslike staff and holds a bright ball of
light.  Some letters are on the mural, they seem to spell the name Igon.

Rooms.Description:
The walls of this hallway are paneled in a dark oiled wood. Candles are set
in sconces to provide light. The floor is a waxed wood and has a fine carpet
that runs the length of the hallway. A stairway is here.

Exits.Description: A lighted hallway leads west.

Rooms.Description:

Exits.Description: The end of the hallway.
A sitting room is to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Sitting Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a cozy yet large sitting room. Two couches are placed with a bear
rug between them in front of a large stone fireplace. The walls are of the same
wood paneling as the halls but pictures are placed on them at various places
about the room.

Exits.Description: A bend in the hallway.
A lighted hallway leads east.

Rooms.Description:

Rooms.Name: The End of the Hallway
Rooms.Description:

in sconces to provide light. The floor is a waxed wood and has a fine carpet
that runs the length of the hallway. Two wooden doors are here, one to the east
and one to the south.

Exits.Description: An ornately carved door.
An ornately carved wooden door.
A bend in the hallway.

Rooms.Name: Vladamir's Bedchamber
Rooms.Description:
This is a room filled with expensive antiques from ages past. A wooden
chair, a vanity, desk, and table are placed in the room. A very expensive rug
covers the floor. A large black coffin is against the south wall.

Exits.Description: An ornately carved wooden door.

Rooms.Name: The Library
Rooms.Description:
Bookshelves are on all the walls of this room. They are filled with books of
all kinds. Most are of no interest to you whatever. A nice large padded chair
and footstool sits at its center. A small table is at its side.

Exits.Description: An ornately carved door.
A trapdoor is under a padded chair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A splendidly comfortable looking chair.  From the marks on the floor it looks
like this chair gets moved a lot.

Rooms.Name: A Stonelined Shaft
Rooms.Description:
A shaft that leads deep within the earth. It is lined with stones and
mortar. The walls are very slippery with a brown slimy mold.

Exits.Description: The shaft continues downward into the dark.

Rooms.Name: The Spiked Pit
Rooms.Description:
O O O O O P S ! You have fallen into a nasty spiked pit! There are several
sharp spikes here to meet you, say HELLO! Strange, they seem to be moving as if
alive?
 
     o-<--< 
    ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ 
    | | | | |

Exits.Description: You see a door concealed within the wall.

Rooms.Name: A Large Cavern
Rooms.Description:
The floor of the cavern is covered with all sorts of junk. There are bits of
armor and weapons, clothing, bones, and other assorted garbage. You even see
the glint of gold and silver coins here and there.

Exits.Description: A small door is to the west.
An earthen tunnel leads up to the surface.
Under the garbage you find a large stone slab.

Rooms.Name: A Small Stone Burial Vault
Rooms.Description:
This ancient vault is totally dark, cold and dry. It is bare except for a
large stone sarcophagus against the east wall.

Exits.Description: The entrance to the vault.
The sarcophagus conceals an entrance.

Rooms.Name: A Large Stone Burial Vault
Rooms.Description:
This vault is huge, but contains only a single large stone sarcophagus. The
entrance you came through has closed by itself. You are alone here. Or are you?

Mobs.Name: skeleton bones
Mobs.Description:
It is a humanoid undead. Made of bones and wearing torn and dirty clothes.
It has no eyes but can still see even in the dark. The monster is like a
machine with only one intent... to harm all that is living.

Mobs.Name: vampire vamp
Mobs.LongDescription: A Vampire grins evilly at you with sharp white fangs.
Mobs.Description: This is a vampire, a poweful undead that drinks the blood of its victims.

Mobs.Name: vladamir vampire vamp count
Mobs.LongDescription: Count Vladamir grins evilly at you with sharp white fangs.
Mobs.Description:
This is a the master of vampires, Count Vladamir. He wears a cloak of
black that he uses to hide his features. He is tall and muscular. Driplets
of blood drop from his white fangs.

Mobs.Name: wraith
Mobs.Description:
This undead is more shadow than anything else. It is so black that you
can not make out its features.

Mobs.Name: swordwraith
Mobs.Description:
This undead is more shadow than anything else. It is so black that you
can not make out its features. This is the undead form of an evil Paladin.
He also wears armor and wields a sword.

Mobs.Name: skeleton warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A Skeleton with sword in hand, attacks you!
Mobs.Description:
This collection of walking bones has a sword in its hand that it is waving
at you!

Mobs.Name: ghoul
Mobs.Description:
This foul smelling creature barely notices that you are here and doesn't
seem to care.

Mobs.Name: ghost
Mobs.Description:
You can see right through this undead.
 Your weapons pass right through it too.

Mobs.Name: zombie
Mobs.Description:
The zombie is a foul looking undead creature.  It wears wormridden clothes
and has various maggots, worms, and flies crawling all over it.  Its mouth is
sewn shut.  Its eyes are wormridden empty sockets that still seem to find you
in the dark.

Mobs.Name: zombie guardian
Mobs.Description:
This putrid looking undead is covered with all sorts of maggots and worms.
He wears a pendant of some sort about his neck and holds what looks like an
hourglass in one hand.

Mobs.Name: spectre
Mobs.Description: This ghost like undead attacks as soon as it sees you.

Mobs.Name: graverobber
Mobs.LongDescription: A Graverobber hides in the shadows.
Mobs.Description:
This grubby human carries a shovel and hooded lantern. He is searching
the graveyard for the largest gravestones where the richest corpses lie.

Mobs.Name: fat fryer
Mobs.Description:
This cleric stands ready to bless all who enter here. He is a jolly fat
man with balding pate and a short beard. He holds a bottle of ale in one
hand and a mace in the other. A key is thrust under his belt.

Mobs.Name: dracolich
Mobs.Description:
This undead creature is the animated remains of a large dragon. Most of
its former flesh and hide is gone to reveal its white bony skeleton.
